description: Official MailChannels skills for sending transactional email from any app

plugins.name: mailchannels
plugins.description: MailChannels Email API is a transactional email API for any application: password resets, sign-in links, verification codes, receipts, invitations and notifications. Send over REST or SMTP with official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, or keep Laravel Mail, Symfony Mailer or Nodemailer and switch the transport. Every API send reports delivery, bounce and complaint events through signed webhooks, with managed DKIM, suppressions and one-click unsubscribe. Optional sub-accounts give each customer, tenant or agent that sends through your product its own API keys, send limit, suspension and activation through the API, suppression list, delivery webhooks, usage reporting and reputation isolation, and each tenant can send from its own domain: a Domain Lockdown record restricts the domain to that tenant's sub-account, DKIM keys are created per domain through the API, and the domain-check API returns pass or fail verdicts for the domain's DKIM, SPF and Domain Lockdown records. Outbound only; free developer plan for development and testing.
